title: 第58章 宠媳妇
content_zh:
第58章 宠媳妇-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

“哎哟，那可太好了！”

王婶拍了拍手上的灰，“素梅身体弱，你得多给她补补。

我这儿还有几个鸡蛋，你拿回去……”

“不用了王婶，家里有。”

“拿着拿着，又不是给你的，给素梅的。”

王婶不由分说地从屋里拿出四个鸡蛋，塞到林国强手里。

林国强推辞了两下，推不掉，只好收了，连声道谢。

林静和林薇在院子里玩泥巴，糊了一脸一手的泥。

林静看见林国强，喊了一声“爸”，举着两只泥手跑过来，要往他身上扑。

林国强赶紧拦住她，一手一个拎起来，夹在腋下，带回了家。

“静静，薇薇，妈妈肚子里有小宝宝了，以后你们要当姐姐了。”

他把两个孩子放在院子里，蹲下来跟她们说。

林静歪着头想了想，问：“小宝宝在妈妈肚子里？那他怎么出来？”

林国强被问得一愣，想了半天不知道该怎么回答，只好说：“等你长大了就知道了。”

林静“哦”了一声，又跑去玩泥巴了。

林薇还小，听不懂这些，但她看见姐姐在玩泥巴，也跟着蹲下去，两只小手在泥巴里搅和，搅得满手满脸都是。

林国强看着两个脏兮兮的女儿，笑着摇了摇头，转身去灶台边给赵素梅做饭。

国强小店的生意越来越好，林国强一个人忙不过来，赵志军也累得够呛。

每天早上四点，两个人就起来了。

林国强和面、卤肉、熬汤，赵志军洗菜、切菜、打下手。

六点半开门，客人陆陆续续地来了，一直忙到下午两点，才能喘口气。

晚上还要准备第二天的食材，常常忙到天黑才收工。

赵志军累得腰都直不起来，但从来没喊过累。

他每天早上从赵家洼骑车过来，晚上再骑回去，来回一个小时，风雨无阻。

林国强要给他加五块钱工资，他死活不要，说“三姐夫你教我手艺就行，钱不钱的无所谓”。

林国强嘴上没说什么，心里记着。

准备到时候给赵志军换辆新自行车。

赵素梅在家养胎，林国强不让她来店里。

她每天在家带两个孩子，做饭、洗衣、收拾屋子，活也不轻。

但比起以前在地里刨食、在店里忙活，已经轻松多了。

林国强变着花样给她做好吃的。

今天炖鸡汤，明天红烧猪肝，后天清蒸鱼。

鸡蛋每天至少两个，奶粉每天早晚各一杯。

"Oh, that's great!"

Aunt Wang patted the dust on her hands and said, "Sumei is weak, so you have to give her some supplements.

I still have a few eggs here, take them back..."

"No, Aunt Wang, we have it at home."

"Take it, take it, it's not for you, it's for Sumei."

Aunt Wang couldn't help but take out four eggs from the house and stuff them into Lin Guoqiang's hands.

Lin Guoqiang declined twice, but couldn't refuse, so he had to accept it and thanked him profusely.

Lin Jing and Lin Wei were playing in the yard with mud, covering their faces and hands with mud.

When Lin Jing saw Lin Guoqiang, she called out "Dad" and ran over with two clay hands, trying to pounce on him.

Lin Guoqiang quickly stopped her, picked them up one by one, put them under his arm, and took them home.

"Jingjing, Weiwei, mommy has a baby in her belly, and you will be sisters in the future."

He put the two children in the yard, knelt down and talked to them.

Lin Jing tilted her head and thought for a while, then asked: "The baby is in the mother's belly? How does he come out?"

Lin Guoqiang was stunned when he was asked. He thought for a long time and didn't know how to answer, so he had to say: "You will know when you grow up."

Lin Jing said "Oh" and ran to play in the mud again.

Lin Wei was still young and didn't understand this, but when she saw her sister playing in the mud, she squatted down too, stirring the mud with her two little hands, until her hands and face were all mixed up.

Lin Guoqiang looked at his two dirty daughters, shook his head with a smile, and turned to the stove to cook for Zhao Sumei.

The business of Guoqiang's store is getting better and better. Lin Guoqiang is too busy alone, and Zhao Zhijun is also very tired.

Every morning at four o'clock, the two of them get up.

Lin Guoqiang kneaded the noodles, braised the meat, and made the soup, while Zhao Zhijun washed, cut, and helped.

The door opened at half past six, and customers came one after another. It was busy until two o'clock in the afternoon, when I could take a breather.

In the evening, I have to prepare ingredients for the next day, and I often end up working until dark.

Zhao Zhijun was so tired that he couldn't straighten his back, but he never complained about being tired.

He rides from Zhaojiawa every morning and back again in the evening, a one-hour round trip, rain or shine.

Lin Guoqiang wanted to give him an extra five yuan in salary, but he refused. He said, "Third brother-in-law, just teach me the craft. It doesn't matter whether you have money or not."

Lin Guoqiang didn't say anything, but kept it in mind.

I am going to give Zhao Zhijun a new bicycle when the time comes.

Zhao Sumei was raising her baby at home, but Lin Guoqiang wouldn't let her come to the store.

She takes care of her two children at home every day, cooking, washing, and cleaning the house. The work is not light.

But it’s much easier than before, digging for food in the fields and working in the store.

Lin Guoqiang cooked delicious food for her in various ways.

Stew chicken soup today, braise pork liver tomorrow, and steam fish the day after tomorrow.

At least two eggs a day, and one cup of milk powder every morning and evening.
